target.subject: Integrated Science
target.outcome: Describe the characteristics of particles in the three states of matter.

sourceIdentity: Resolve UUIDs from the live curriculum library response; never use legacy chunk labels as API IDs.

cases.label: grounded_success
cases.signal: Real provider path: curriculum retrieval, generation, deterministic QA, rubric QA, usage, and cost.

cases.label: deterministic_repair_pass
cases.signal: First response has activity durations that miss 40 minutes; the correction preserves the plan and fixes timing.

cases.label: deterministic_repair_failure
cases.signal: Both model responses miss the requested duration total; the API must save no draft.

cases.label: official_grounding_missing
cases.signal: Synthetic teaching sources cannot replace the official excerpt that defines the selected outcome.

cases.label: citation_provenance_failure
cases.signal: A fabricated source UUID is rejected even when the lesson text otherwise matches the outcome.

cases.label: semantic_grounding_gap

deterministic.limitation: Citation identity and membership do not establish that each claim follows from the cited passage.

suggestionConcepts: remove or qualify the particle-size claim
cite the supplied synthetic teaching note

cases.signal: The KICD outcome names particle characteristics but does not establish that particle size remains unchanged; semantic support needs rubric or human review.

cases.label: malformed_output_repair
cases.signal: Malformed JSON is treated as invalid model output and receives one correction attempt.

cases.label: schema_failure_after_repair
cases.signal: Missing required lesson fields after correction fails before persistence.

cases.label: rubric_strong
cases.signal: A coherent plan should earn evidence-linked scores and specific suggestions for any score below four.

cases.label: rubric_borderline
cases.signal: The tasks align, but crowded transitions and vague closure leave observable quality gaps.

cases.label: rubric_weak
cases.signal: A structurally valid plan can still drift from the particle outcome and lack evidence of individual understanding.

cases.label: retry_after_success
cases.signal: A 429 with Retry-After is retried once and then the same request completes.

cases.label: retry_exhaustion
cases.signal: Repeated transient 503 responses exhaust the bounded retry policy; no draft is saved.

cases.label: non_retryable_auth_failure
cases.signal: A 401 is returned immediately without retry or draft persistence.
